claim_checks.partition_design: 20 balanced $10/10/20$ partitions of the same 48 instances
claim_checks.balanced_counts: five times in fitting, five in selection and ten in testing
claim_checks.retrospective: after the original E1 outcomes were known
claim_checks.original_kept: The original split remains the primary analysis and is excluded from the alternative-partition average.
claim_checks.unchanged_costs: original methods, ideal references, shot blocks and costs
claim_checks.dependent_ranges: ranges across dependent partitions, not confidence intervals
claim_checks.directions_both_budgets: preserves both full-cost directions in every partition at both budgets
claim_checks.cluster_method: rates are first averaged over partitions within each instance, followed by 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of the 48 complete instance clusters
claim_checks.inference_scope: without adding independent observations or testing transfer to new landscapes
